kind: Frozen selection before detector output for a practical human Sentinel-2 review pilot

shortlist.reason: Verified civilian demolition, but public metadata for September 9-October 14 contains only two baseline days and one target day (October 11), with 39.88/42.65 percent scene clouds in the overlapping tiles. A clearer October 16 target shifts the unchanged rolling baseline past September 11, leaving only one baseline day. No detector output was used.

shortlist.candidate: Genoa remaining eastern Morandi viaduct demolition June 28, 2019
shortlist.reason: Independently dated large civilian transport alteration on predominantly land. Six catalog baseline days and a low scene-cloud July 1 target support one bounded review attempt. AOI mask coverage and visible usefulness remain unknown.

selection_sources.supports: City account dated June 28, 2019 reports demolition of the eastern remains at 09:37 local. Reconstruction had already begun, so the baseline includes works.
City event recap identifies the two remaining eastern piers 10 and 11, demolished June 28, 2019.

Official June 26 evacuation map locates the eastern works around Via Walter Fillak, Via Porro and the railway yard, east of the Polcevera. Contextual locator; not a georeferenced demolition footprint.
Current Via Walter Fillak street geometry cross-checks the analyst-selected location. Modern geometry does not establish 2019 surfaces.

independent_validation.method: Separate bounded agent checked primary city evidence, official locator map, street geometry and public CDSE metadata before selection. No detector output or satellite pixels were read.
independent_validation.catalog_agreement: Independent slightly enclosing bbox and exact production-grid polygon query returned the same seven SAFE product IDs and six baseline/one target days.
independent_validation.timestamp_caveat: CDSE ContentDate is a product sensing reference. Earth Search tile timestamps differ and are not silently substituted. Earth Search may list original N0212 and reprocessed N0500 versions; these do not create extra acquisition days.

proposed_live_action_not_executed.review_previews: review-case requests every usable comparison, including detector negatives
proposed_live_action_not_executed.requires: Sensor-selection integration, approved merged commit and specific authorization for one bounded EE analysis/render run.
